# Norma

> Norma is a design prototype for a legal-tech assistant (French law practice). Built with Create React App (React 18, JavaScript) and Tailwind CSS v3, using the "Plato" stone + cream design theme. This file maps the design-system surface so AI agents can navigate the repo and build on-brand UI.

## Design system

- [Design tokens](src/design-system/tokens.js): canonical color, spacing, typography, shadow and radius tokens — the single source of truth.
- [Global styles](src/index.css): CSS custom properties, badge variants, base element styles.
- [Tailwind config](tailwind.config.js): theme extension exposing tokens as utilities.
- [Component & token catalog](src/data/designSystemInventory.json): machine-readable inventory (statut, Figma, notes) surfaced at `/ui-kit`.
- [Component docs](src/data/componentDocs.json): généré depuis les fiches `src/components/ui/*.md` (`npm run ds:docs`).
- [Token usage docs](docs/tokens.md): usage de chaque token, généré par `npm run ds:tokens`.

## Components

- [UI-kit primitives](src/components/ui-kit/previews.jsx): Button, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch, Select, Combobox, Textarea, Modal, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, Tabs, Table, Avatar, Skeleton, and chat primitives.
- [JP components](src/components/jp): jurisprudence search, decision drawers, add/rationale steppers, pills and rows.
- [Pièces components](src/components/pieces): document pile split/fusion flow, bordereau table, folder modals, review banners.
- [Rédaction components](src/components/redaction): acte canvas, outline, bordereau, pièce pickers, export menu.

## Conventions

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): toolchain, design-system entry points, and coding conventions.
- No emojis in UI; hyphens over em-dashes in copy; tokens over hardcoded values.

- [README](README.md): Create React App getting-started.
